subject: [AMBER] Question about obtaining PMEMD.CUDA for AMBER 2024

messages.author: Angel David Montijo Valdés
messages.body:
To whom it may concern,
Good morning, I hope you find this email well, I am respectfully addressing
you with the intention of knowing what are the prices on the installation
of pmemd.cuda module? or failing that, what is the price of the license to
use pmemd.cuda? This is because my team at the National Institute of
Pediatrics (INP) in Mexico in charge of Dr. Gabriel Lopez Velazquez, we are
interested in acquiring it for its great potential to perform molecular
dynamics simulations much faster.
We look forward to hearing from you and send you our best regards.
Sincerely, Angel David Montijo Valdes

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:

There is no license fee for non-commercial use of Amber (which includes
pmemd.cuda.)  Please visit
https://ambermd.org/GetAmber.php
, and follow the
instructions there.
(This page also has information on commerical licensing, if that is of
interest to you.)
...regards....dave case
